title: Scammers Wanted $3,000 - They Watched Me Spend It All
summary: Kitboga baits tech-support scammers into believing they will get $3,000, wasting hours of their time while he plays along and screen-shares. The scammers become frustrated as it becomes clear the money will not reach them.
why: HN commenters point to Kitboga as an entertaining, righteous example of wasting scammers' time.

quote.text: One of my favourite videos so far involved “driving to a store” to get google play codes
